To avoid oesophageal ulceration, tablets of emepronium bro- mide should always be swallowed with an adequate volume of water, and patients should always be in the sitting or standing position while, and for 10 to 15 minutes after, taking the tablets. Emepronium is contra-indicated in patients with symptoms or signs of oesophageal obstruction or with pre-existing oesophag- itis. Buccal and oesophageal ulceration.
